evidence.span: 🚨 FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY: Officials are warning of the imminent failure of McLeod Dam, with potentially life-threatening flooding downstream

timeline.text:
🚨 FLASH FLOOD EMERGENCY: Officials are warning of the imminent failure of McLeod Dam, with potentially life-threatening flooding downstream.

🏃 EVACUATE: Residents in Garfield and Salem are being advised to evacuate immediately and move to higher ground.

🎒 TAKE ESSENTIALS: If you live in an evacuation area, bring medications, identification, important documents, necessary supplies, and items for children and pets.

🏫 GARFIELD ELEMENTARY: Students have been safely transported to Hatch Valley High School, where parents can pick them up.

🏠 SHELTER: Shelters are open at the Radium Springs Community Center and Doña Ana Community Resource Center for families displaced by the evacuation.

📱 STAY INFORMED: Follow updates from Doña Ana County and local emergency officials, and do not wait to evacuate if you are in an affected area. Click here to track road closures: https://t.co/TvrxEj3uZe
